brief.headline: Tata Steel Seals APL Apollo Deal; Global AI Rebounds as Nvidia Reinstates Huang
brief.summary: Indian markets are set to react to Tata Steel's massive restructuring and acquisition involving APL Apollo Tubes alongside soft oil import prints. Globally, AI stocks and equity futures are surging following Nvidia's unanimous reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO.

takeaways.text: Tata Steel announced a strategic partnership to acquire a 26.4% stake in APL Apollo Tubes and transfer assets in a multi-billion deal, causing APL Apollo shares to crash 15%.
Adani Airport Holdings raised ₹2,790 crore from 360 ONE Asset to fund expansion plans and boost passenger capacity.
PTC Industries rebounded after securing an Indian Defence Order for 400 tonnes of titanium products.
Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, triggering a massive rally in global tech and AI shares.
CrowdStrike announced a major $44 billion all-stock deal to acquire cybersecurity provider Zscaler.

sections.india: Indian equities open following a sharp correction in the previous session, with Bank Nifty and metal stocks under pressure. Tata Steel's acquisition of a stake in APL Apollo Tubes and transfer of its tubes business will drive heavy action in both counters. Meanwhile, Adani Airport raised ₹2,790 crore to fund expansions, and PTC Industries rebounded after bagging a major defence order.
sections.world: Global markets are staging a strong relief rally as US futures rebound from an AI-driven correction. Nvidia shares soared over 30% following the board's swift reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO. Meanwhile, CrowdStrike entered into a massive $44 billion agreement to acquire Zscaler, and European chip stocks advanced.
sections.tech: AI and technology sectors are dominated by Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang, easing severe market jitters. Arm CEO Rene Haas extended his contract through 2033 after rebuffing approaches from Nvidia. Additionally, startups like Zavya and Matters.AI secured fresh funding rounds while cybersecurity deals reshaped enterprise software landscapes.

The investment boom could lift Asia's investment-to-GDP ratio to 32% and boost its global export share.

stories.title: Bret Taylor’s Sierra Finalizing More Than $1.75 Billion Round
stories.summary: Sierra Technologies Inc., a startup that makes artificial intelligence software to automate customer service, is finalizing a funding round of more than $1.75 billion that would value the company at $30 billion.

stories.title: Why are SpaceX lenders worried about Elon Musk sending billions of dollars' worth of Nvidia chips into space?
stories.summary: SpaceX lenders have reportedly sought guarantees that billions of dollars worth of Nvidia AI chips backing a $44 billion financing deal will remain on Earth. The move comes as Elon Musk explores plans to build solar-powered orbital data centres using satellites to run AI workloads in space.
stories.ai_summary: SpaceX lenders sought guarantees that Nvidia AI chips backing a $44 billion financing deal will remain on Earth.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights stringent collateral requirements for space-tech debt deals.

stories.title: Alice Huang in touch with Chinese spy agency during affair with Nvidia CEO: Report
stories.summary: Alice Huang was in touch with an officer from China's Ministry of State Security from the spring of 2025 until the fall of this year, the report said, citing people with knowledge of intelligence reports that describe the encounters.
stories.ai_summary: Reports linked Alice Huang to Chinese intelligence officers during her association with Nvidia's former chief executive.
stories.why_it_matters: Adds geopolitical and regulatory scrutiny to tech leadership.

stories.title: Musk warns delay in data center buildout could leave AI companies short of capital as pushback, revenue concerns grow
stories.summary: AI data center construction faces growing financial and operational risks, Elon Musk warned, arguing that delays in spending on computing capacity could strain companies’ cash. The sector also faces local resistance, infrastructure bottlenecks and numerous delayed or blocked projects.

stories.title: Nvidia Reinstates Huang as CEO, Trump Says No Risk to Security
stories.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer less than two weeks following his remarkable ouster, after US government support. Nvidia shares gained more than 31%.

stories.title: US Probing Alice Huang, Megaspeed Amid Ties to Nvidia
stories.summary: The US is investigating Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy who had an affair Nvidia’s former chief executive, Jensen Huang, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton said Sunday. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.summary: Marlowe, a six-month-old startup co-founded by two Microsoft Corp. vice presidents, has raised $277 million to pursue ways to boost computing power from chips that rival Nvidia Corp.’s processors.

stories.summary: Microsoft President Brad Smith defended the need for data centres outside the United States after President Donald Trump threatened penalties on companies building them abroad, saying services used by businesses and consumers must operate close to their customers.

stories.summary: Amazon.com Inc. has agreed to acquire much of startup Decart AI, buying tools to bolster the cloud-computing company’s artificial intelligence infrastructure.

stories.summary: Pierre Ferragu, New Street Research global team head of technology infrastructure, says he's very happy Jensen Huang is back as ceo of Nvidia. Ferragu says it became apparent that Nvidia would not do as well without Huang at the helm. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: Sam Altman joins OpenAI’s chief scientist Jakub Pachocki in calling for common industry standard on powerful AI models
stories.summary: Jakub Pachocki called for AI developers to set common thresholds for powerful models and avoid exceeding them until safety capabilities improve. Sam Altman backed the proposal, which could use measures such as perplexity, as industry leaders face growing concerns about AI’s rapid advancement.
